name: haptic-driver-review
display_name: AI Remote A0 — haptic driver review (unrouted)

message: The "Q" prefix is being used with a <chip />, try using it with a <transistor />
All pins on Q9 are underspecified (no pinAttributes set)
U22 has no pin with requires_power=true
Q9 has no pin with requires_power=true
Q9 has no pin with requires_ground=true
Q9 is missing schematic reference designator text. For a custom symbol, add name="{REFDES}" inside the symbol.
